> - One 16-step array per drum. Kick, snare, hats, and nothing else to begin with.
> - Accent with amplitude and shift hats slightly late to get the pocket you built in Lesson 16.
> - Transcribe a groove you like by repeated listening, one instrument at a time.
>
> **Ends with: a groove stored as readable arrays rather than an opaque loop.**
:::
